text.lead: Jake Squared is a 2013 comedy drama film directed by Howard Goldberg, and starring Elias Koteas, Virginia Madsen, Mike Vogel, Jane Seymour, Jennifer Jason Leigh and Gia Mantegna. It was filmed in Hollywood.
text.plot: A filmmaker sets out to make a new project in order to figure out how he's screwed up every relationship he's ever had. The filming spirals out of his control and he winds up having what's either a mystical experience, a nervous breakdown, or both, as his past selves and loves literally and hysterically catch up with him.
text.reception: The review aggregator Rotten Tomatoes reports a 22% approval rating, based on nine reviews with an average score of 4.75/10.
